performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real but lumpy; revenue spikes mask thin purchase frequency.

findings.text: ROAS fell 70.18% week-over-week while spend rose 28.1%; last 3 days (Sep 8–10) show only 6 purchases on $159.23 spend vs 7 purchases on $166.28 the prior 3 days — diminishing returns confirmed at current budget.

Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (due Aug 14), Pre-Launch Gate, Platform Ownership Decision, Funnel Test + UTM Live, and SEO Phase 1 Guardrails (all due Aug 31) show no completed event — 5 milestones overdue by 11–28 days.
GBP actions hit zero on Sep 6–10 (5 consecutive days, down from 23–47/day prior) — channel_dark signal; likely a profile suspension or listing issue, not an ads problem.
Revenue is lumpy and spike-driven: Sep 15 alone was $1,727.93 of the 28-day $7,148.81 total; strip that day and 28-day ROAS drops below 3.5x — the 4.81x headline overstates structural performance.

Top campaign BWS - Sales - Muslims consumed $839.56 (57% of 28-day spend); with purchase events firing inconsistently via Shopify, the 36-purchase count and 4.81x ROAS should be treated as directional, not precise.

suggestions.text: Hold any further spend increases on BWS - Sales - Muslims; do not scale — freeze daily budget at current $58.98/day pending creative refresh.
suggestions.monday_update: ROAS dropped 70.18% week-over-week while spend rose 28.1%, and the last 3 days (Sep 8–10) produced only 6 purchases — the campaign is scaling into diminishing returns. Hold the daily budget at its current ~$58.98/day level; do not approve any increase until new creative is live. Success check: 3 consecutive days at or above the 28-day baseline ROAS of 4.81x before any upward budget move. Re-evaluate by Sep 14.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing immediately — 5 dark days (Sep 6–10) from 23–47 actions/day represents a confirmed profile issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to zero for 5 consecutive days (Sep 6–10) after averaging 23–47 actions/day — this is a confirmed channel-dark event, not a seasonal dip. Nacer to check for a suspended or suppressed Google Business Profile listing today. Success check: GBP actions return to ≥15/day within 3 days of the fix being applied. Re-check Sep 14.

suggestions.text: Watch Funnel Test result and UTM live status (overdue Aug 31); no paid scaling or subscribe-page work until this closes.
